title: Script Hub
features:
# 🌟 VY Hub | Sword Factory Script

### 🗡️ Sword Scanner
* **Custom God-Roll Sniper:** Set up to 5 profiles to automatically hunt for specific 3-enchant combos.
* **Creator ID Tracker:** Snipe swords made by specific players, or scan all server drops.
* **Meta Presets:** 1-click toggles for the best god-roll builds.
* **Smart Alerts:** Screen highlights and sound pings the exact second your target sword drops.

### 🌍 NPC Tracking
* **Global Area Radar:** Track high-rarity mobs in all major zones from anywhere on the map.
* **Screen Alerts:** Giant on-screen warnings and sounds when a God Roll NPC spawns.
* **Local Mob ESP:** Clean ESP for nearby mobs based on the rarity you set.

### 🔮 Spawn Predictor
* **Spawn Predictor:** Calculates the exact ETA for the next Triple or Quad God Spawn.
* **Live Timer:** Real-time countdown and spawn tracker right on your screen.
* **10-Spawn Warning:** Audio alert right before a God Roll drops so you're always ready.
* **Quick Server Hop:** Instantly teleports you to a better server if your current one is dead.

### 👤 Player ESP
* **Global Player Tracker:** Scans the entire map to show you exactly who is farming inside specific high-tier zones (like Volcanic Isles or Mineshaft).
* **Player Loadout ESP:** See exactly what weapons, classes, and rarity other players are holding.
* **Health & Distance Tracker:** Live HP bars, exact health numbers, and distance tracking.

### ⚙️ Settings & Optimization
* **Clean UI:** Smooth, draggable dark-mode interface.
* **Auto-Save Configs:** Saves all your profiles and toggles automatically.
* **Lag-Free:** Highly optimized to keep your FPS high during heavy farming.
* **Mobile & PC Friendly:** Built to work flawlessly on almost any executor.

---
**Keybinds:**
* `Right-Control` - Hide/Show Menu
